G2504.strongs: so also the dative case, and accusative case and (or also, even, etc.) I, (to) me
G2504.kjv: (and, even, even so, so) I (also, in like wise), both me, me also
senses: ἐγώ, genitive, etc., ἐμοῦ, ἐμοί, ἐμέ (enclitic μου, μοι, με), pl. ἡμεῖς, -ῶν, -ῖν, -ᾶς, of person(s) pron. I.

The nom. is usually emphatic, when expressed as subjc, as in [[r:MAT.3.11|Mat 3:11]], [[r:MRK.1.8|Mrk 1:8]], [[r:LUK.3.16|Luk 3:16]], al. But often there is no apparent emphasis, as [[r:MAT.10.16|Mat 10:16]], [[r:JHN.10.17|Jhn 10:17]]; ἰδοὺ ἐ. (= Heb. הִנֵּנִי, cf. [[r:1KI.3.8|1Ki 3:8]]), [[r:ACT.9.10|Act 9:10]]; ἐ. (like Heb. אֲנִי), I am, [[r:JHN.1.23|Jhn 1:23]] (LXX), [[r:ACT.7.32|Act 7:32]] (LXX).

The enclitic forms (see supr.) are used with nouns, adjectives, verbs, adverbs, where there is no emphasis: ἐν τ. πατρί μου, [[r:JHN.14.20|Jhn 14:20]]; μου τ. λόγους, [[r:MAT.7.24|Mat 7:24]]; ὀπίσω μου, [[r:MAT.3.11|Mat 3:11]]; ἰσχυρότερός μου, ib.; λέγει μοι, [[r:REV.5.5|Rev 5:5]]; also with the prep. πρός, as [[r:MRK.9.19|Mrk 9:19]], al. The full forms (ἐμοῦ, etc.) are used with the other prepositions, as δι᾽ ἐμοῦ, ἐν ἐμοί, εἰς ἐμέ, etc., also for emphasis, as [[r:LUK.10.16|Luk 10:16]], [[r:JHN.7.23|Jhn 7:23]], [[r:MRK.14.7|Mrk 14:7]], al. (with) The genitive μου and ἡμῶν are often used for the poss. pronouns ἐμός, ἡμέτερος: τ. λαόν μου, [[r:MAT.2.6|Mat 2:6]]; μου τῂ ἀπιστιᾳ, [[r:MRK.9.24|Mrk 9:24.]]

τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί ( = Heb. מַה־לִי וָלָךְ, [[r:JDG.11.12|Jdg 11:12]], al.), i.e. what have we in common: [[r:MAT.8.29|Mat 8:29]], [[r:MRK.1.24|Mrk 1:24, 5:7]], [[r:LUK.8.28|Luk 8:28]], [[r:JHN.2.4|Jhn 2:4]]; τί γάρ μοι, [[r:1CO.5.2|1Co 5:2.]]
The interchange of ἐγώ and ἡμεῖς, common in π., appears in Pauline Epp. (see M, Pr., 86f., M, Th., 131f.).

Bl., § 24), in LXX and NT fut. also, to sit, be seated: [[r:MAT.11.16|Mat 11:16 22:44]]" (LXX), [[r:MRK.2.6|Mrk 2:6]], [[r:JHN.6.3|Jhn 6:3]], [[r:ACT.2.2|Act 2:2]], [[r:JAS.2.3|Jas 2:3]] (on the vulgar imper. κάθου, see Kennedy, Sources, 162), [[r:REV.4.3|Rev 4:3]], al.; before prep. with accusative, ἐπί, [[r:MAT.9.9|Mat 9:9]], [[r:MRK.2.14|Mrk 2:14]], [[r:JHN.12.16|Jhn 12:16]]; παρά, [[r:MAT.13.1|Mat 13:1]], [[r:MRK.10.46|Mrk 10:46]]; περί, [[r:MRK.3.32|Mrk 3:32, 34]]; πρός, [[r:LUK.22.56|Luk 22:56]]; ὑπό, [[r:JAS.2.3|Jas 2:3]]; εἰς, [[r:MRK.13.3|Mrk 13:3]]; μετά, with genitive of person(s), [[r:MAT.26.58|Mat 26:58]]; ἐκ δεξιῶν, [[r:MAT.22.44|Mat 22:44]]; ἐπάνω, with genitive, [[r:MAT.28.2|Mat 28:2]]; ἀπέναντι, with genitive, [[r:MAT.27.61|Mat 27:61]]; ἐπί, with dative, [[r:ACT.3.10|Act 3:10]]; id. with genitive, [[r:ACT.8.28|Act 8:28]]; ἐκεῖ, [[r:MAT.15.29|Mat 15:29]]; pleonastic (M, Pr., 230, 241; Dalman, Words, 22), [[r:MAT.13.2|Mat 13:2]], [[r:ACT.23.3|Act 23:3]], [[r:REV.18.7|Rev 18:7]]; metaphorically, [[r:MAT.4.16|Mat 4:16]], [[r:LUK.1.79|Luk 1:79]]" (LXX); of one's domicile ([[r:NEH.11.6|Neh 11:6]], [[r:SIR.50.26|Sir 50:26]]; Hdt., v, 63), [[r:LUK.21.31|Luk 21:31]], [[r:ACT.2.2|Act 2:2]], [[r:REV.14.6|Rev 14:6]] (cf. συν-κάθημαι) (AS)

G2560.kjv: amiss, diseased, evil, grievously, miserably, sick, sore

in moral sense, wrongly ([[r:1MA.7.42|1Ma 7:42]], 4Mac, l.with, al.): κ. λαλεῖν, [[r:JHN.18.23|Jhn 18:23]]; είπεῖν, with accusative of person(s), [[r:ACT.23.5|Act 23:5]]; αἰτεῖσθαι, [[r:JAS.4.8|Jas 4:8]],† (AS)

G2523.strongs: to seat down, i.e. set (figuratively, appoint); intransitively, to sit (down); figuratively, to settle (hover, dwell)
senses: causal, to make to sit down, set, appoint: [[r:ACT.2.30|Act 2:30]], [[r:1CO.6.4|1Co 6:4]], [[r:EPH.1.20|Eph 1:20]].

Intrans., to sit down, be seated, sit: [[r:MAT.5.1|Mat 5:1]], [[r:MRK.9.35|Mrk 9:35]], [[r:LUK.7.15|Luk 7:15]], [[r:JHN.8.2|Jhn 8:2]], al.; with inf. tel., [[r:1CO.10.7|1Co 10:7]]; before εἰς, [[r:2TH.2.4|2Th 2:4]]; ἐπί, with accusative, [[r:MRK.11.2|Mrk 11:2]], [[r:JHN.12.14|Jhn 12:14]]; id. with genitive, [[r:JHN.19.13|Jhn 19:13]], [[r:ACT.12.21|Act 12:21]]; ὧδε, [[r:MRK.14.32|Mrk 14:32]]; αὐτοῦ, [[r:MAT.26.36|Mat 26:36]]; ἐν δεξιᾷ, [[r:HEB.1.3|Heb 1:3]]; ἐκ δεξιῶν, [[r:MAT.20.21|Mat 20:21, 23]]; ἐν, [[r:REV.3.21|Rev 3:21]]; καθίσας pleonastic (M, [[r:PRO.14.1|Pro 14:1-35]]; Dalman, Words, 22), [[r:MAT.13.48|Mat 13:48]], [[r:LUK.5.3|Luk 5:3 14:31 16:6]]; of settling in a place (ἐς χωρίον, Thuc., iv, 93), before ἐν, [[r:LUK.24.49|Luk 24:49]] (cf. ἀνα-, ἐπι-, παρα-, περι-, συν-καθίζω) (AS)

Physically: [[r:MAT.23.26|Mat 23:26 27:59]], [[r:JHN.13.10|Jhn 13:10-11]] (fig.), [[r:JHN.15.3|Jhn 15:3]] (figuratively, as of a vine cleansed by pruning), [[r:HEB.10.22|Heb 10:22]], [[r:REV.15.6|Rev 15:6 19:8, 14 21:18, 21]].

of persons: [[r:JHN.13.16|Jhn 13:16]], [[r:ACT.18.6|Act 18:6]], [[r:TIT.1.15|Tit 1:15]]; ό κ. τῇ καρδίᾳ (καθαρὸς χεῖρας, Hdt., i, 35), [[r:MAT.5.8|Mat 5:8]]; before ἀπό (cl. with genitive simp.; ΒΙ., § 36, 11; Deiss., BS, 196; MM, Exp., xv), [[r:ACT.20.26|Act 20:26]];

G2588.root: prolonged from a primary κάρ (Latin cor, "heart")
G2588.strongs: the heart, i.e. (figuratively) the thoughts or feelings (mind); also (by analogy) the middle
senses: the bodily organ which is regarded as the seat of life ( [[r:2KI.18.14|2Ki 18:14]], [[r:2KI.9.24|4Ki.9:24]], al.).

In a psychological sense, the seat of man's collective energies, the focus of personal life, the seat of the rational as well as the emotional and volitional elements in human life, hence that wherein lies the moral and religious condition of the man (DB, ii, 317f.; DGG, ii, 344a);

of the seat of spiritual life: [[r:MAT.5.8|Mat 5:8]], [[r:MRK.7.19|Mrk 7:19]], [[r:LUK.1.51|Luk 1:51]], [[r:ACT.5.3|Act 5:3]], [[r:ROM.10.9|Rom 10:9, 10]] [[r:EPH.6.5|Eph 6:5]], al.; pl., [[r:MAT.9.4|Mat 9:4]], [[r:MRK.2.6|Mrk 2:6]], al.; opposite to στόμα, χείλεα, πρόσωπον, [[r:MAT.15.8|Mat 15:8]], [[r:MRK.7.6|Mrk 7:6]], [[r:ROM.10.8|Rom 10:8]], 9 [[r:2CO.5.12|2Co 5:12]]; περιτομὴ καρδίας, [[r:ROM.2.29|Rom 2:29]]; ἐκ κ., [[r:ROM.6.17|Rom 6:17]], [[r:1PE.1.22|1Pe 1:22]]; ἀπὸ τῶν κ., [[r:MAT.18.35|Mat 18:35]]; ἐν ὅλῃ (ἐξ ὅλης), [[r:MAT.22.37|Mat 22:37]], [[r:MRK.12.30|Mrk 12:30]]" (LXX); γινώσκειν (ἐρευνᾶν, δοκιμάζειν) τὰς κ., [[r:LUK.16.15|Luk 16:15]], [[r:ROM.8.27|Rom 8:27]], [[r:1TH.2.4|1Th 2:4]]; to think, etc., ἐν τ. κ., [[r:MAT.9.4|Mat 9:4]], [[r:MRK.2.6|Mrk 2:6]], [[r:LUK.12.45|Luk 12:45]], [[r:ROM.10.6|Rom 10:6]]; συνιέναι (νοεῖν) τῇ κ., [[r:MAT.13.15|Mat 13:15]], [[r:JHN.12.40|Jhn 12:40]]; ἐπαχύνθη ἡ κ., [[r:MAT.13.15|Mat 13:15]] (LXX); πωροῦν τὴν κ., [[r:JHN.12.40|Jhn 12:40]]; κ. εὐθεῖα, [[r:ACT.8.21|Act 8:21]]; πονηρά, [[r:HEB.3.12|Heb 3:12]]; ἀμετανόητος, [[r:ROM.2.5|Rom 2:5]]; εἶναι (ἔχειν) ἐν τῇ κ., [[r:2CO.7.3|2Co 7:3]], [[r:PHP.1.7|Php 1:7]]; ὀδύνη τῇ κ., [[r:ROM.9.2|Rom 9:2.]]
Of the central or innermost part of anything (of the pith of wood, Arist.): τ. γῆς, [[r:MAT.12.40|Mat 12:40]] (Cremer, 343ff.). (AS)

G2545.strongs: to set on fire, i.e. kindle or (by implication) consume
senses: to kindle, light: with accusative, λύχνον, [[r:MAT.5.15|Mat 5:15]]; pass., to be lighted, to burn: ptcp., [[r:LUK.12.35|Luk 12:35]], [[r:REV.4.5|Rev 4:5 8:10 19:20]]; πυρί [[r:HEB.12.18|Heb 12:18]], [[r:REV.8.8|Rev 8:8 21:8]]; metaphorically, [[r:LUK.24.32|Luk 24:32]], [[r:JHN.5.35|Jhn 5:35]].

G2503.strongs: "iota", the name of the eighth letter of the Greek alphabet, put (figuratively) for a very small part of anything

senses: (by crasis for καὶ ἐκεῖ, and so sometimes written, see infr.), and there, there also: [[r:MAT.5.23|Mat 5:23]] (κ. ἐ., Tr., mg.) [[r:MAT.10.11|Mat 10:11 28:10]] (κ. ἐ., T), [[r:MRK.1.35|Mrk 1:35]] (κ. ἐ., L) [[r:MRK.1.38|Mrk 1:38]] (κ. ἐ., WH) [[r:MRK.14.15|Mrk 14:15]] (κ. ἐ., WH), [[r:JHN.11.54|Jhn 11:54]], [[r:ACT.14.7|Act 14:7 17:13 22:10 25:20 27:6]].† (AS)

G2549.strongs: badness, i.e. (subjectively) depravity, or (actively) malignity, or (passively) trouble
senses: badness in quality (opposite to ἀρετή, excellence).

In late Gk., evil, trouble, affliction ([[r:AMO.3.6|Amo 3:6]], [[r:1SA.6.9|1Ki 6:9]], [[r:ECC.7.15|Ecc 7:15]], [[r:SIR.19.6|Sir 19:6]], al.): [[r:MAT.6.34|Mat 6:34]] (cf. MM, Exp., xv).† SYN.: (πονηρία) (AS)

(Hellenistic-FlJ, Inscr.-for Attic καθαίρω, which see, on the vulgar -ερ-, [[r:MAT.8.3|Mat 8:3]], [[r:MRK.1.42|Mrk 1:42]], see Bl., § 6, 1; Thackeray, Gr., 74) to cleanse, make clean.

[[r:SIR.38.10|Sir 38:10]]); τ. χεῖρας, [[r:JAS.4.8|Jas 4:8]]; λαὸν ἑαυτῷ, [[r:TIT.2.14|Tit 2:14]]; τ. ἐκκλησίαν, [[r:EPH.5.26|Eph 5:26]]; with accusative of person(s) (of thing(s)), before ἀπό (131., § 36, 9; Deiss., BS, 216 f.), [[r:2CO.7.1|2Co 7:1]], [[r:HEB.9.14|Heb 9:14]], [[r:1JN.1.7|1Jn 1:7]] [[r:JHN.1.9|Jn 1:9]].

senses: Καναναῖος, -ου, ὁ (late Heb. קָנָא), a Cananæan or Zealot (cf. ζηλωτής): [[r:MAT.10.4|Mat 10:4]], [[r:MRK.3.18|Mrk 3:18]] (Rec. -νίτης).† (AS)

G2563.strongs: a reed (the plant or its stem, or that of a similar plant); by implication, a pen
senses: a reed: [[r:MAT.11.7|Mat 11:7 12:20]]" (LXX) [[r:LUK.7.24|Luk 7:24]]; hence, accusative, to its various uses,

a reed-staff, staff (cf. [[r:2KI.18.21|4Ki.18:21]], ῥάβδος καλαμίνη): [[r:MAT.27.29|Mat 27:29-30, 48]], [[r:MRK.15.19|Mrk 15:19, 36]]; (with) a measuring reed or rod (Ez, l.with): [[r:REV.11.1|Rev 11:1 21:15-16]];
a writing reed, a pen: III Jn 13 (cf. Milligan, NTD, 9, 7).† (AS)

(καλός), finely, rightly, well: [[r:LUK.6.48|Luk 6:48]], [[r:1CO.14.17|1Co 14:17]], [[r:GAL.4.17|Gal 4:17 5:7]], [[r:JAS.2.3|Jas 2:3]]; λέγειν, λαλεῖν, etc., [[r:MAT.15.7|Mat 15:7]], [[r:MRK.7.6|Mrk 7:6 12:28]], [[r:LUK.6.26|Luk 6:26 20:39]], [[r:JHN.4.17|Jhn 4:17 8:48 13:13 18:23]], [[r:ACT.28.25|Act 28:25]]; as exclamation of approval, [[r:MRK.12.32|Mrk 12:32]], [[r:ROM.11.20|Rom 11:20]]; κ. ποιεῖν, [[r:MAT.12.12|Mat 12:12]], [[r:1CO.7.37|1Co 7:37-38]] [[r:JAS.2.8|Jas 2:8, 19]]; with dative of person(s) (cl. accusative; WM, § 32, 1 β), [[r:LUK.6.27|Luk 6:27]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MRK.7.37|Mrk 7:37]]; with ptcp., [[r:ACT.10.33|Act 10:33]] (M, Pr., 131), [[r:PHP.4.14|Php 4:14]], [[r:2PE.1.19|2Pe 1:19]], 3Jn 6; προϊστάναι (-ασθαι), [[r:1TI.3.4|1Ti 3:4 3:12 5:17]]; διακονεῖν, [[r:1TI.3.13|1Ti 3:13]]; ἀνατρέφεσθαι, [[r:HEB.13.18|Heb 13:18]]; ironically, [[r:MRK.7.9|Mrk 7:9]], [[r:2CO.11.4|2Co 11:4]] (but see CGT, in l); κ. ἔχειν, to be well: [[r:MRK.16.18|Mrk 16:18.]] Compar., κάλλιον (for superl., B1., § 44, 3), very well: [[r:ACT.25.10|Act 25:10.]]† (AS)
